acceptance: reverts the dark-mode output of pure black, pure white and palette black: given revertDarkModeFilter("#ededed"), revertDarkModeFilter("#121212") and revertDarkModeFilter("#d3d3d3"), expect "#000000", "#ffffff" and "#1e1e1e" respectively
preserves alpha: given revertDarkModeFilter("#d3d3d380") and revertDarkModeFilter("#d3d3d3ff"), expect "#1e1e1e80" and "#1e1e1e" (full opacity has no alpha suffix)
returns the input unchanged when disabled: given revertDarkModeFilter("#d3d3d3", false), expect "#d3d3d3"

round-trips %s within ±1 per channel: given each subject not in ROUND_TRIP_EXCEPTIONS, roundTrip = revertDarkModeFilter(applyDarkModeFilter(color)), expect roundTrip matches /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/ and every channel of toChannels(roundTrip) minus toChannels(color) has absolute value <= ROUND_TRIP_TOLERANCE

records the measured round trip of clamped colour %s: given each ROUND_TRIP_EXCEPTIONS entry, expect revertDarkModeFilter(applyDarkModeFilter(entry.color)) toBe entry.roundTrip, and the signed per-channel error toEqual entry.error
lists only palette colours as exceptions: given the names of ROUND_TRIP_EXCEPTIONS and the subject list, expect every exception's name is a subject name and its color equals that subject's color
matches the dark-mode pixel of palette yellow[2] exactly: given matchDarkModeColor(applyDarkModeFilter("#ffd43b"), []), expect "#ffd43b"
recovers clamped palette colour %s exactly: given each ROUND_TRIP_EXCEPTIONS entry, matchDarkModeColor(applyDarkModeFilter(entry.color), []), expect entry.color
prefers a scene colour over the palette and returns it verbatim: given matchDarkModeColor(applyDarkModeFilter("#ffd43b"), ["#FFD43B"]), expect "#FFD43B"
matches a scene colour that is not in the palette: given matchDarkModeColor(applyDarkModeFilter("#123456"), ["#ffc9c9", "#123456"]), expect "#123456"
ignores alpha on the picked and the candidate colour: given matchDarkModeColor(`${applyDarkModeFilter("#1e1e1e")}80`, ["#1e1e1e80"]), expect "#1e1e1e80"

skips transparent and invalid scene colours: given matchDarkModeColor(applyDarkModeFilter("#000000"), ["transparent", "not-a-colour"]) (both render like #000000 in dark mode, and no palette colour does), expect null
returns null when no candidate matches: given matchDarkModeColor("#123456", []), expect null
